baseline_models.mechanism: The passive plural makes the addressees the objects brought into view, while the cognate verb-noun repetition around خ ف ي denies every successful concealment.

activation_trace.role: Presenting a thing to view supplies the literal display operation and makes the plural addressees its displayed objects.
Covering and hiddenness supply the state explicitly negated, making disclosure exhaustive rather than merely public.

changed_reading.before: The people simply appear in public on that day.
changed_reading.after: The people are made objects of an exhaustive display in which concealment no longer functions.

baseline_models.mechanism: The antipodal revealing branch inside خ ف ي makes the negation dynamic: presentation does not only illuminate what was already exposed but removes cover and draws hidden contents out.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something forward to be seen supplies the destination of the extraction.
Removing concealment and bringing a thing out supplies an active uncovering process within the repeated focus root.

changed_reading.before: Previously hidden facts happen to be visible.
changed_reading.after: The presentation actively extracts what had occupied cover and brings it into the field of view.

baseline_models.mechanism: The outer and inner faces of indirect expression meet physically hidden inner things. What issues 'from you' can therefore include an unspoken inner face, not only an externally concealed object.

activation_trace.role: Indirect wording with an outer and inner face supplies the distinction that presentation collapses.
Covers and physically hidden inner things supply the concealed interior now treated as issuing from the persons.

changed_reading.before: No externally hidden object escapes notice.
changed_reading.after: No private inner face, equivocation, or covered interior remains separated from the presented exterior.

baseline_models.mechanism: Presentation can set a person up as an exposure-point, while ع ر ض also reaches the person's body, visible face, and honor. The whole socially vulnerable person, not an abstract dossier alone, stands liable to view.

activation_trace.role: Being set up or made liable supplies the addressees' condition as exposure-points.
Personal honor, body, and visible facial sides widen what is exposed from information to embodied standing.
The denial of covering removes the protections normally separating private person, body, and reputation from view.

changed_reading.before: A person's deeds are shown while the person remains a spectator.
changed_reading.after: The entire person is set up as the liable and unshielded object of presentation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening's repeated Reality is something established and manifested, the knowledge question names the epistemic gap, denial can wear a deceptive garment, and the Striking Event rebukes the hearer. Together they revise display into forced verification: hidden reality becomes knowable by defeating its false outer presentation.

activation_trace.role: Presentation to view supplies the focus operation that can function as proof rather than spectacle.
Removing concealment supplies the transition from unknown interior to manifested evidence.
Establishing and manifesting truth turns the final display into an event that verifies reality.
Knowledge and discernment supply the result that the opening question withholds and disclosure later produces.
A garment that lies by its appearance supplies a concrete false exterior for disclosure to strip away.
A rebuke that strikes the hearer makes verification coercively undeniable rather than calmly observational.

structural_cues: 69:1-3 repeats الحاقة and encloses it in escalating questions before the historical denial.
69:4 places تكذيب immediately beside the naming of the striking event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies manifestation, withheld knowledge, deceptive appearance, and auditory rebuke; I infer a procedure in which exposure produces compelled recognition. A live alternative is that these cues intensify the event without specifying an evidentiary procedure.

changed_reading.before: An already understood set of secrets is publicly shown.
changed_reading.after: Presentation is the event by which contested reality is established, deceptive surfaces fail, and what could not be grasped becomes undeniable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The destructive sequence is both extirpating and residue-free. Its visible question about any surviving remnant becomes an informational analogue for the focus: no hidden remainder stays outside the presentation.

activation_trace.role: Presentation to view supplies the final field within which completeness is tested.
Hiddenness supplies the possible residue whose survival the negation denies.
Extirpating action supplies the mechanism that carries destruction through to its endpoint.
What remains of a thing supplies the explicit residue category that the preceding question fails to find.

structural_cues: 69:8 asks فهل ترى لهم من باقية after the extirpating sequence.
69:18 answers with لا تخفى منكم خافية; both clauses test an indefinite feminine remainder through a negative frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies physical extirpation, a search for a remnant, and the later denial of a hidden item; I infer that physical zero-remnant closure becomes a model for informational closure. The alternative is a formal echo without transfer of mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Disclosure is broad but may still leave marginal residue outside the scene.
changed_reading.after: The presentation is residue-zero: there is no surviving hidden remainder beyond its account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The addressee is first positioned as one who sees ruined bodies and searches for remnants, then as an ear that receives and contains meaning, and finally as the plural object presented. Perception reverses direction: the observer and container becomes observable content.

activation_trace.role: Presentation to view supplies the passive endpoint in which the former perceiver becomes the perceived object.
Seeing by eye and insight supplies the addressee's earlier role as active witness.
Containing meaning in the heart makes the perceiver also a repository whose contents can later be exposed.
Listening and accepting what is heard supply the receptive stage before the addressee is presented.

structural_cues: The second-person ترى occurs in 69:7 and 69:8, while 69:18 changes to the passive second-person plural تعرضون.
69:12 inserts an ear that receives and retains between the scenes of seeing and being seen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the person-shift from seeing to receiving to being presented; I infer a deliberate reversal in which witnesses themselves become evidence-bearing objects. The alternative is simple continuity of address without a role reversal.

changed_reading.before: The addressee watches the final disclosure from outside it.
changed_reading.after: The earlier viewer and hearer crosses into the visual field, carrying received and retained contents that are themselves presented.

context_deltas.mechanism: Overrunning water increases and flows until covered contents cannot remain in place. This activates the extraction branch of خ ف ي: presentation can be an emergence forced by overwhelming pressure, not only placement before an observer.

activation_trace.role: Removing cover and bringing hidden things out supplies the focus's pressure-driven emergence.
Something looming or appearing from a direction supplies the newly emerged contents' arrival in view.
The overwhelming rise and sweeping force of water supply the pressure that defeats cover.
Water appearing, entering, and becoming abundant supplies the medium that penetrates hidden spaces.
Flow and unconfined movement supply the transport from concealment into exposure.

structural_cues: 69:11 sequences the water's transgression before carrying in the vessel.
The focus's خ ف ي inventory explicitly preserves removal of cover as a live branch rather than hiddenness alone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overwhelming water, abundant entry, flow, and a focus branch of extraction; I infer that fluid pressure drives concealed contents outward. The live alternative is that the flood remains a historical rescue scene and contributes only intensity.

changed_reading.before: Hidden contents are calmly inspected after being placed on display.
changed_reading.after: They are forced out of cover by an overwhelming process and only then loom into the field of presentation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Disobedience to a messenger leads to being seized for fault by an intensified taking. Against that chain, being set up as liable in 69:18 becomes custodial presentment after apprehension rather than a neutral viewing.

activation_trace.role: Being set up or made liable supplies the focus's formal condition of presentment.
Failed concealment removes any private refuge from the liable person's presentment.
Departure from obedience supplies the antecedent breach.
Messenger and message supply the communicated obligation against which the breach is legible.
Taking a person to account for fault supplies the apprehensive and punitive link to presentment.
Increase and elevation supply the seizure's intensified scale.

structural_cues: 69:10 gives a compact breach-to-consequence chain: عصوا ... فأخذهم أخذة رابية.
The passive تعرضون in 69:18 leaves the presented persons under an unnamed acting authority.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies breach, message, punitive seizure, and liability; I infer that the final passive display continues an accountability procedure. The alternative is that 69:10 remains an analogy of punishment without specifying the legal character of 69:18.

changed_reading.before: Presentation is neutral exposure to sight.
changed_reading.after: Presentation is a liable person's formal appearance after apprehension for a communicated breach.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence carries a burden, makes it a reminder, and places meaning in a receptive vessel. Hiddenness thus acquires a non-deceptive counterpart: faithfully retained contents can later be unpacked as testimony when presentation removes their cover.

activation_trace.role: A cover or physically hidden inner thing supplies the repository-like interior in which retained content resides.
Bringing hidden contents out supplies the later release of what had been retained.
Bearing an entrusted burden supplies durable carriage rather than evasive concealment.
A reminder that actively recalls supplies the preserved content and its future evidentiary function.
Enclosing something in a vessel supplies the storage mechanism later opened by disclosure.

structural_cues: 69:11 moves from carrying persons in the vessel to 69:12 making the event a reminder.
69:12 repeats و ع ي as verb and adjective around the ear, foregrounding retention.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies carriage, reminder, containment, and later extraction; I infer continuity from preservation to evidentiary release. A live alternative is that 69:12 concerns mnemonic receptivity only and does not project stored testimony into 69:18.

changed_reading.before: Every hidden thing is culpable concealment that must be defeated.
changed_reading.after: Presentation also opens what persons faithfully carried and retained, converting private memory into available testimony.

context_deltas.mechanism: A single-direction operation levels the hard landscape, the event falls and becomes fixed, and the overhead canopy splits into a weakened tear. The focus's breadth, crosspieces, and hidden interiors then read spatially: the stage itself is opened into a cross-section before people are presented.

activation_trace.role: Breadth and the lateral dimension supply the exposed plane produced by leveling.
Crosswise structural pieces supply an architectural register for a world whose supports are broken open.
Hidden inner places and covers supply the interiors eliminated when the cosmic structure is opened.
Uniting things in one direction supplies the singular operation that collapses spatial distinctions.
Pounding and demolishing until level supplies the production of an unobstructed exposure plane.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies the event's decisive settlement into actuality.
Splitting and opening supply the breach of the upper enclosure.
The sky as what rises and covers supplies the canopy whose opening removes overhead concealment.
A tear or breach in a covering supplies the canopy's failure as shelter.

structural_cues: 69:13-14 repeats واحدة across the blast and the crushing.
69:15, 69:16, and 69:18 repeat يومئذ, tightly linking cosmic opening to human presentation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies singular force, leveling, fixed occurrence, a split covering, and lateral focus branches; I infer that dismantling the environment creates the physical condition of total exposure. The alternative is that the cosmic signs and human presentation are successive but mechanistically independent.

changed_reading.before: People are brought onto an intact stage for inspection.
changed_reading.after: The stage is first leveled and opened into a cosmic cross-section, so neither people nor hidden interiors retain a sheltering side.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the old canopy fails, attendants occupy its edges and visibly carry an elevated royal seat under sovereign lordship. This replaces collapse with a governed vertical order, sharpening ع ر ض into formal muster, comparison, and presentment before authority.

activation_trace.role: Presenting to view, including ordered review, supplies the formal muster at the focus.
Correspondence and comparison supply an evaluative relation within the presentation.
The angel branch supplies the attendants occupying the opened scene.
The edge or side of a thing supplies a bounded perimeter after the sky's rupture.
Lifting a visible burden supplies the supported central structure.
A raised royal seat supplies the scene's governing center.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty supply the authority before whom presentment occurs.
Superiority by domination supplies the vertical authority relation over those present.

structural_cues: 69:17 spatially orders الملك at the edges, carriers below, and the throne above them.
69:18 follows this architecture immediately with the passive plural تعرضون.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attendants, perimeter, carriers, elevated seat, sovereignty, and superiority; I infer that this spatial order makes the following display a formal audience or muster. The alternative is a cosmographic scene that does not determine the social form of presentation.

changed_reading.before: Total exposure occurs as an unstructured aftermath of cosmic collapse.
changed_reading.after: Exposure is an ordered presentment within a newly established hierarchy, with perimeter, support, sovereign center, and evaluative comparison.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ثمانية is numerically eight in context while the cited same-root branch is price and value, and ع ر ض reaches merchandise offered in exchange. It remains anchored in تُعْرَضُونَ and in packet-provided branches, but downstream prose should present it only as a cross-branch valuation resonance, never as a replacement translation of ثمانية.

activation_trace.role: Goods offered for exchange supply an appraisal register latent in the focus presentation.
Price and value in exchange supply the possible act of valuation activated beside the numeric surface.
The one and numerical units supply a counting frame within which appraisal can be imagined as itemized.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, presentation also places each person and hidden item into an itemized field of appraisal and value.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it transfers the material reversals of overturned settlement, leveled terrain, and split canopy into the person's disclosure. It remains anchored by the focus branches of an outer and inner verbal face and physically hidden interiors. Render it as an inside-out spatial analogy for total exposure, not as a claim that any focus word literally means overturning.

activation_trace.role: Wording with outer and inner faces supplies the two-sided structure that can be reversed.
Physically hidden inner things supply the interior brought to the outside.
Turning a thing away from its face or direction supplies the reversal operation.
Demolition until level supplies the loss of enclosing depth.
Splitting and opening supply the breach through which the inner face becomes outer.

changed_reading.before: A cover is lifted from otherwise stable persons and surroundings.
changed_reading.after: The persons and their world are rendered inside out, so the former interior itself becomes the presented face.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rare faint-lightning branch of خ ف ي and links it to blast and split sky. It remains anchored in the repeated focus root and in the appearing branch of ع ر ض, but should be rendered only as an atmospheric image of sudden disclosure, not as a lexical identification of خافية with lightning.

activation_trace.role: A faint lightning glimmer emerging from cloud supplies a minimal visibility that can suddenly intensify.
What looms or appears from a direction supplies the flash's passage into the field of view.
Sending air into a thing supplies the sudden initiating blast.
Splitting and opening supply the break through cloudlike cover.
The overhead sky and covering supply the atmospheric enclosure from which the disclosure flashes.

changed_reading.before: Disclosure is a steady, uniformly lit inspection.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it arrives like a formerly faint flash breaking through a split cover until nothing remains imperceptible.

strongest_changes: The ترى-to-تُعْرَضُونَ sequence reverses the addressee from observer and receptive container into the object presented.
حُسُومًا followed by the search for a بَاقِيَة recasts no hidden thing as residue-zero informational closure.
The one crushing, fixed event, and split weakened sky make exposure a cosmic cross-section; the edge-and-throne arrangement then restores it as ordered presentment.
Carriage, reminder, and containment preserve a coexisting reading in which disclosure releases retained testimony rather than defeating deceit alone.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots carry unusually opposed and cross-domain branches: خ ف ي names both covering and removal of cover, while ع ر ض ranges from display through liability, outer-inner wording, bodily honor, structural breadth, and offered goods. Context therefore activated several mechanisms that cannot be merged without loss: verification, extraction, role reversal, zero remainder, memory release, spatial opening, and formal audience.
remaining_uncertainties: The passive تُعْرَضُونَ does not itself name the viewer, so the formal tribunal reading remains a context-supported inference.
The scope of مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ remains open among hidden acts, thoughts, inner faces, retained memories, and anything issuing from the persons.
The hydraulic, valuation, inside-out, and faint-flash readings are packet-anchored but branch-distant; they should coexist as qualified activations rather than govern a final interpretation.
